Hey everyone, I have a simple (I hope) question. 
We're currently on our first year of our B1 visa and at the mean while we've gotten married. We've went to PIBA for a file conversion (הסבת תיק). We're now waiting for the next appointment to deliver documents and about a month after that we have the second interview. 

At what point does one get the ID (תעודת זהות)? I asked on our last meeting over there and from what I recall we were told you get it after in the interview (either straight after or not long after) but I am really not sure. 

Can someone corroborate or correct me?

Thank you!
